evidence.note: Legend above the chart names both bar colours: white swatch = Q2 2026, pale green swatch = Q3 2026.
Q2 bars each carry a direct percentage label (86%, 85%, 85%, 87%) and category labels below.
Q3 bars carry direct values (81%, 70%, 74%, 87%); the green target line is labelled 'Target 90%'.
At the small size the legend, value labels and 'Target 90%' label all remain visible and readable.
Overlay dims the chart but adds no new colour encoding; values remain faintly legible behind it.

rationale: Both colour series are explained by a legend and every bar carries its value, and the only other coloured mark (the target line) is text-labelled. No meaning depends on colour alone, matching the pass descriptor.
